data.one_liner: An emoji picker component for Flutter with support for the latest emojis and skin tones.
data.what_it_does: Provides an Emoji Selector widget that can be embedded anywhere in your application or used within a modal bottom sheet as a keyboard. It returns an EmojiData object via callback when an emoji is selected.
use_when: You need to allow users to pick emojis inside your chat or messaging app.
You want an emoji picker with search and skin tone customization.
avoid_when: You need a different type of picker such as file or color picker.
strengths: Supports the latest emoji versions and skin tones.
Easy to integrate as a widget or modal bottom sheet.
weaknesses: Limited configuration documentation available in the README.

alternatives.name: emoji_picker_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative emoji picker package available in the catalog.
